rules: Administrative inspection returns the authoritative instance, definition, contained descendants, and validation issues.
Administrative movement requires an explicit canonical destination and preserves runtime identities.
Portable-container subtree movement propagates one authoritative owner and rejects circular or contradictory placement.
Administrative repair remains evidence-gated by projected durability and maximum_durability.
Administrative removal is explicit and reports its override status.
Administrative audit runs runtime-state and global limited-item reconciliation without mutating state.
classic_boundary: This policy does not claim original MajorMUD sysop command syntax, permissions, messages, or native repair formulas.
